target.label: Shadow Run (U) [!]
target.authenticity_and_rights: Hash/header/checksum establish byte identity and structural consistency only; they do not establish publisher provenance, ownership, or reuse rights.

identity_comparison.comparison_basis: The exact SHA-1 and CRC-32 match the canonical USA ROM identity listed by shadowrun-defragged README at its inspected revision; the independently computed local SHA-256 is recorded above.
identity_comparison.caveat: This is a byte-identity comparison to that project’s declared canonical source, not proof of authenticity or rights.

reconstruction_source.license_status: No license file appears in the pinned repository root; the GitHub license endpoint returned 404. Do not assume the code or derived assets are licensed for reuse.

opening_path.source_reported: Title/start options -> Choose Archetype -> timed new-game opening -> field scene ID 2. The three Joshua choices in the source audit are Samurai, Decker, and Gator Shaman; choosing one copies its 0x100-byte template into live record 0xFF0100 via source routine 0x42B0. The timed opening tables/routines are identified as 0x5ADD0/0x5ADF0 and 0x59C5E/0x59D7C/0x5AA96/0x5AD1A.
opening_path.place_name_qualification: The pinned source project calls this the Redmond Barrens startup map by comparing scene-2 trigger coordinates with a separate public map; the ROM stores numeric IDs and does not contain this place name in the scene table.
opening_path.startup_encounter_source_claim: The source audit says the completed opening leaves FFE18B set and the post-warmup continuation opens Stoker’s arrival dialogue at scene-2 record 91. This is a source/conversion-project claim; this task did not independently observe the original cartridge’s live sequence.
opening_path.native_scope: No original-ROM runtime probe or full original-versus-reconstruction visual comparison was performed by this research pass; root owns the original native probe.

scene_resources.profile_evidence: Local reads of the selected ROM resolved these pointer values; they match the pinned source profile table.
source_decoder_boundaries: field scene entry/load paths include 0x03074/0x03084 and 0x0313A
terrain stream decoding references 0x01610; collision record iteration references 0x0EE10

source_first_interactions.record_91: 0x00C2 at 0x173138; source project assigns the Stoker arrival dialogue override
source_first_interactions.record_92: 0x00CB at 0x173142; source project assigns the Ares service override
source_first_interactions.records_89_90: 0x00C0 at 0x173124 and 0x17312E; row 0 at 0x172CDC selects numeric scene 0x14

scene_resources.resource_composition: The inventory describes scene terrain as separately decoded layers, stream/descriptor/collision/event data and actor assets. It is not one full-screen image. The intro is likewise assembled from background planes, sprite lists, overlays and timed SAT groups.

movement_source_crosswalk.0x195C_and_0x19D2: decompilation/ghidra_conversion/src/field/field_movement_input_conversion.cpp; normalized D-pad heading decode; partial conversion.
movement_source_crosswalk.0x0BABC: decompilation/ghidra_conversion/src/field/field_movement_input_conversion.cpp; heading to eight-way ordinal; partial conversion.
movement_source_crosswalk.0xB530: gameplay/scripts/actor_ai.lua approach_heading plus typed reference helper in decompilation/ghidra_conversion/src/entities/entity_coordinate_conversion.cpp; source step advances heading by 0x0800, snaps within one step; NPC collision route remains open.
movement_source_crosswalk.reuse_license: No root LICENSE found at pinned commit; GitHub license endpoint 404. No assumption of reuse permission.

claims_and_limits.locally_observed: Exact file length, SHA-256/SHA-1/CRC-32, parsed Genesis header/checksum, and the numeric pointers/record values listed above.
claims_and_limits.source_reported: Opening progression, scene-2 place-name crosswalk, source function labels, sprite/map extract paths, and documented input interaction routes.
claims_and_limits.inference: Scene 2 is the best initial interactive segment to target for an opening-playable-area reconstruction, subject to native observation and a source-faithful visual/resource audit.
claims_and_limits.unknown: Publisher authenticity/rights; whether the pinned third-party reconstruction is complete/currently behaviorally faithful; exact scene-entry visual/timing on original hardware; any physical Genesis behavior.
